name: Eurocodes (recommended values)
description: The Eurocodes with their recommended values. Loads and seismic actions (version 0.1, alpha 9 track C4): EN 1990 (combinations 6.10 or 6.10a/b, characteristic, frequent and quasi-permanent combinations, ψ factors, partial factors of set B), EN 1991-1-1 (imposed loads by category, αA and αn), EN 1991-1-3 (snow on roofs), EN 1991-1-4 (peak velocity pressure, walls, cscd), EN 1991-1-7 Annex D (internal gas explosions) and EN 1998-1 (ground types, Type 1 and 2 spectra, importance classes, behaviour factors, lateral force and modal analysis, drift and θ). Concrete (version 0.2, alpha 9 track C5): EN 1992-1-1 design strengths with partial factors, the stress block by strength class, shear by the variable strut inclination method, torsion, punching, stress, crack and span/depth checks, cover by exposure class, anchorage, laps and member steel (concreteMethods), with EN 1998-1 Section 5 detailing for DCM and DCH, and EN 1997-1 partial factor sets, design approaches DA1-DA3, bearing (Annex D), sliding and pile resistance with the correlation factors (geotechnicalMethods). The other material and member design tables (steel, the concrete methods not yet covered, the foundation design itself ...) come from the pack it extends, BNBC 2020. A National Annex is a pack that extends this one and sets only its Nationally Determined Parameters. Every value is listed in VERIFY.md for checking against the printed codes.
